definitions.de: Spät am Morgen (ca. 9–11 Uhr); auch: Linie, Streifen oder Schnur
definitions.en: Late morning (approximately 9–11 a.m.); also can mean a line, string, or stripe
definitions.es: Mañana tardía (aproximadamente de 9 a 11 a.m.); también puede significar línea, cuerda o franja
definitions.fr: Fin de matinée (environ 9h–11h) ; peut aussi signifier une ligne, une corde ou une rayure
definitions.hi: देर सुबह (लगभग 9–11 बजे); इसका अर्थ रेखा, धागा या पट्टी भी हो सकता है
definitions.ja: 遅い午前（午前9時〜11時頃）；また、線、紐、縞模様を意味することもある
definitions.km: ពេលព្រឹកយឺត (ប្រហែល ៩ ដល់ ១១ ព្រឹក); ក៏អាចមានន័យថា បន្ទាត់ ខ្សែ ឬបន្ទះ
definitions.ko: 늦은 오전 (대략 오전 9~11시); 선, 줄, 또는 줄무늬를 의미하기도 함
definitions.ne: बिहानको ढिलो समय (लगभग ९–११ बजे); रेखा, धागो वा पट्टीको अर्थ पनि हुन सक्छ
definitions.pt: Final da manhã (aproximadamente 9–11 da manhã); também pode significar linha, corda ou faixa
definitions.th: สาย (ช่วงเช้าสาย ประมาณ 9-11 โมง); ยังหมายถึงเส้น เชือก หรือแถบได้ด้วย
definitions.tl: Huling umaga (mga 9–11 ng umaga); maaari ring mangahulugang linya, sinulid, o guhit
definitions.ur: دیر صبح (تقریباً صبح 9 سے 11 بجے)؛ لکیر، ڈوری یا دھاری کے معنی بھی ہو سکتے ہیں
definitions.vi: Buổi sáng muộn (khoảng 9–11 giờ sáng); cũng có thể có nghĩa là đường thẳng, dây, hoặc sọc
definitions.zh: 上午较晚的时段（大约上午9至11点）；也可以指线条、绳子或条纹
definitions.zh_Hant: 上午較晚的時段（大約上午9至11點）；也可以指線條、繩子或條紋

definition_en: Late morning (approximately 9–11 a.m.); also can mean a line, string, or stripe

lao_examples.lao_script: ຕື່ນສາຍ, ໄປຮຮຮຮຮຮຮຮ ຮຮ ບໍ່ທັນກິນເຂົ້າເຊົ້າ
lao_examples.romanization: tʉ̀ʉn sǎaj, bɔ̀ than kin khâo sâo
lao_examples.translation_en: Woke up late in the morning, didn't have time to eat breakfast.

lao_examples.lao_script: ສາຍໆ ແລ້ວ, ລຸກໄປອາບນໍ້າໄດ້ແລ້ວ
lao_examples.romanization: sǎaj sǎaj lɛ́ɛo, lúk paj àap nám dâaj lɛ́ɛo
lao_examples.translation_en: It's already late morning, you can get up and take a shower now.
